integration.static_overcurrent_templates: Static overcurrent. Templates without mapping. No PF validation.
integration.protection_pairs_per_fault_m: Protection pairs per fault, margin and coverage
integration.the_report_contains_a_questi: The report contains a question mark inside a word
integration.references_with_matching_cas: References with matching cases and options are required for N-1, PV/QV sweeps, derivatives and daily profiles. Short circuit requires boundary equivalents, source contributions, sequences, taps and converter data. RMS and CCT require synchronized signals, events, criteria and time-step comparison.
integration.the_external_system_equivale: The external-system equivalent is retained for boundary balance. Its individual quantities are not interpreted as physical network demand, generation or losses.
integration.synthetic_data_are_used_only: Synthetic data are used only for numerical execution tests.
integration.n_1_cases_ordered_by_minimum: N-1 cases ordered by minimum voltage. Failed cases are flagged without assigning zero voltage.
integration.contingency_classification_r: Contingency classification requires checking diagnostics and coverage against an external reference.
integration.load_flow_limits_and_control: Load flow limits and controls verification
integration.each_of_d_selected_elements_: Each of %d selected elements was removed individually. The deterministic study separates new islands from Newton failures. There are %s islanding cases and %.2f MW of new unsupplied demand accumulated across cases, which do not represent a simultaneous loss. Non-convergence does not prove collapse.
integration.fictitious_source_at_the_cri: Fictitious source at the critical busbar
integration.qv_positive_q_injection_into: QV: positive Q injection into the network. This is not an installed capacity.
integration.pv_three_internal_busbars_an: PV: three internal busbars and the last converged point. Subsequent non-convergence does not prove collapse.
integration.local_ac_derivatives_of_crit: Local AC derivatives of critical voltage are computed for active and reactive injection at the same busbar, balanced at the reference. They apply only to the base-point control regime. LODF and error are omitted because they were not computed for this perturbation.
integration.the_critical_busbar_was_regu: The critical busbar was regulated by a fictitious source over %d voltage setpoints, with positive Q injection into the network. The computed interval is %.3f to %.3f p.u. and requires %.3f to %.3f Mvar. This does not determine compensator size or reserve.
integration.only_positive_internal_physi: Only positive internal physical demand was increased, preserving power factor and the external equivalent. The last converged point reaches an increase of %.3f MW. Balance is assigned to the idealized reference. The numerical boundary depends on controls and steps and does not certify a physical PV nose or real external reserve.
integration.synthetic_sk_test_data_energ: Synthetic Sk'', test data, energized busbars
integration.synthetic_sk_test_data_minim: Synthetic Sk'', test data. Minimum, median and maximum positive currents by voltage level.
integration.a_th_venin_boundary_uses_syn: A Thévenin boundary uses synthetic Sk'' of 10000 MVA, X/R=10 and c=1.1 as test data. It summarizes %d busbars with positive current, excluding de-energized busbars and unevaluable cases. No actual interface level or IEC conformity is claimed.
integration.ik_by_level_synthetic_sk_tes: Ik'' by level, synthetic Sk'', test data
integration.the_official_load_flow_was_c: The official load flow was checked without enabling controls or defining new setpoints. Exported tap and bank positions are retained. Available Q limits are compared with results. Without qualified voltage bands or loading thresholds these quantities are not classified. The result is partial and zero violations do not imply compliance of unevaluable elements.
integration.no_evaluable_cct_interval_ha: No evaluable CCT interval has stable and unstable boundaries and a time-step check. No safe clearing time is published.
integration.metrics_are_computed_on_the_: Metrics are computed on the selected RMS run. Every window and horizon comes from study configuration. Thresholds are indicative and do not establish regulatory compliance or recovery outside the horizon.
integration.no_interpretable_results_for: No interpretable results for this calculation.
integration.engine_state_series: Engine state series. No extrapolation beyond the computed window.
integration.run_has_no_signals: The run does not contain signals.csv
